strings: m_c has always nodded off during inoppritone moments. m_c has narcolepsy.
m_c keeps falling asleep every time {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/try/tries} to rest for just a moment.
After {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/fall/falls} asleep in the middle of camp yet again, r_c diagnoses {PRONOUN/m_c/object} with narcolepsy.
